author: SussyBabaka
quote:
This is not a GTA game.

You're not free to do anything.

You can't shoot every person.

You can't steal every car.

You can't do this, you can't do that.

This is a dating simulator game.

The story is mid, characters are mid, and the dialogues are cringe.

The degeneracy in this game also feels performative and forced.

It also doesn't have gyroscope aiming settings, and the "streamer mode" (Mute Licensed Music) doesn't replace the muted music with anything else. So it becomes very awkward in many scenarios.

The game only relies on photorealistic graphics and real-life realistic mechanics (super boring) as plus points.

The performance on the PS5 Pro is also bad. You can't make any excuse for this with a $2 billion budget and years of development.

13 years of waiting results in disappointment.

I'll give one point for the graphics and world building, which you should've expected to improve .
